summary: Encodes two float color channels into packed 32-bit words: each channel is scaled by 32768.0 and stored as a 16-bit unsigned value (first channel in low 16 bits, second in high 16 bits). If the format-conversion flag is set, the vertex buffer format is converted first. Encodes a count of vertices given by this[1046] in a do-while loop, returning a conversion-state global.

operations.description: Guard on this[1042] (+0x1048): if non-zero, vertex buffer format conversion runs before encoding.
Call DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion(this, a4) to transform the input vertex buffer format.
Replace vertex data pointer a4 with the format-conversion result.
Compute texel base v6 = this[11] (+0x2C) + 4 * ((a3 & 3) + 8 * (a2 & 3)), selecting an element from the 4x4 texel block addressed by the low 2 bits of a2/a3.
Call UtilityFunction_7473 unconditionally before the encode loop.
Guard on vertex count this[1046] (+0x1058): if zero, the do-while body never executes.
Do-while loop over this[1046] (+0x1058) vertices; counter v4 increments, byte offset v8 advances by 16 each iteration.
Per vertex: v11 = float(a4+v8) * 32768.0 + float(v6 + 4*(v4&3)) and v10 = float(a4+v8+4) * 32768.0 + float(v6 + 4*(v4&3)); emit (u16)v11 | ((u16)v10 << 16) into the output stream.
